shortDescription: BitcoinTreasuries.NET said on X that Singapore-listed Bitcoin mining company BitFuFu has added 59 Bitcoin to its holdings, bringing its total to 1,373 BTC. According to Odaily, BitFuFu ranks 39th in the Bitcoin 100 list.
